newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Italy says welcomes S.Korean investment.
newsitem.headline: Italy says welcomes S.Korean investment.

text.p: Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini on Friday called on South Korean companies to increase investment in Italy and seek more joint ventures.

"I've found huge interest (among South Korean companies) in investing in Italy," Dini told a news conference at the end of a three-day visit to Seoul. "The focus (of my visit) was to find sectors where cooperation may be made."
He also said Italy wanted bilateral trade to be more balanced, but added the current imbalance in favour of Italy had been due to market trends.
South Korea exported a total of $1.03 billion to Italy in calendar 1995, compared to $2.43 billion worth of imports.
